name: Template: Product Roadmap
description: Track features from idea through launch and monitoring. Each swimlane is a product area; each card is a feature or initiative.

swimlanes.name: Mobile App
swimlanes.notes: iOS and Android. Targets field workers and on-the-go board access.

swimlanes.name: Core Platform
swimlanes.notes: Web app, API, and shared infrastructure features.

swimlanes.name: Integrations
swimlanes.notes: Third-party integrations: Slack, GitHub, Jira, Zapier, webhooks.

swimlanes.name: Analytics
swimlanes.notes: Board analytics, cycle time, throughput, and reporting features.

swimlanes.name: Compliance & Security
swimlanes.notes: GDPR, SOC 2, audit logging, and security hardening features.

swimlanes.name: Collaboration
swimlanes.notes: Real-time collaboration, comments, mentions, and notification features.

swimlanes.name: Import & Export
swimlanes.notes: Data portability: CSV, JSON, API bulk operations, and migration tools.

swimlanes.name: Automation
swimlanes.notes: Rule-based automation: auto-move, auto-assign, scheduled actions.

swimlanes.name: Admin & Settings
swimlanes.notes: Board and site administration, user management, billing, and configuration.

swimlanes.name: Search & Discovery
swimlanes.notes: Full-text search, filtering, saved views, and cross-board discovery.

custom_fields.name: RICE score
custom_fields.help_text: Reach x Impact x Confidence / Effort.

custom_fields.name: Enterprise only
custom_fields.help_text: Ships only in the enterprise edition.
